overview: Following the successful completion of BATCH-59, the simulation has achieved stable high-depth operation. This batch focuses on the final optimization of the endgame state to ensure deterministic reproducibility and minimal memory footprint for long-running sessions. We are closing the gap between raw simulation data and efficient archival storage, while finalizing the psychological model for colonist adaptation to deep-mantle conditions.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Copy Deterministic State Hasher
tasks.architectural_spec: Create a constexpr-friendly struct `StateHasher` using `std::span<const uint8_t>` for input. Implement a custom FNV-1a variant optimized for 64-bit integers. Use `std::bit_cast` for type-punning. No dynamic allocation. The hasher must process the entire simulation state buffer in a single pass. Include a static assertion for endianness. Provide a `finalize()` method returning `uint64_t`. Ensure all operations are noexcept. Integrate with the existing `TickManager` to hash state every 100 ticks.
acceptance_criteria: Hasher produces identical `uint64_t` for identical state buffers across 1000 runs.
Zero heap allocations during hashing phase.
Unit tests cover edge cases: empty buffer, single byte, max uint64.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save/load consistency and enables rapid state comparison for debugging and replay systems.

tasks.title: Optimize Deep-Mantle Pressure Gradient Calculation
tasks.architectural_spec: Refactor the pressure gradient calculation to use a precomputed lookup table for depth-to-pressure conversion. Define a `constexpr` array of 1024 entries mapping depth indices to pressure values. Implement a linear interpolation function `lerp` for intermediate depths. Use `std::array` for the lookup table. The main calculation function should take `uint16_t depth_index` and return `float pressure`. Remove all floating-point divisions in the hot path by using reciprocal constants. Ensure the table is generated at compile-time using `constexpr` loops.
acceptance_criteria: Lookup table generated at compile time.
Calculation time per tick reduced by >40% compared to BATCH-59.
No runtime initialization of the lookup table.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother frame rates during deep exploration sequences, reducing stutter in high-depth zones.

tasks.title: Compact Colonist Psychological State Bitfield
tasks.architectural_spec: Define a `struct PsychState` using `uint32_t` bitfields for core attributes: `mood` (4 bits), `energy` (4 bits), `hunger` (4 bits), `thirst` (4 bits), `status_flags` (16 bits). Implement `constexpr` getters and setters using bitwise operations. Add a `to_string()` method that formats the state into a compact 16-character string for UI display. Ensure the struct is trivially copyable and fits within 4 bytes. Provide a `merge` function to combine two states using bitwise OR for flags and average for numeric values.
acceptance_criteria: UI display string is always 16 characters long.
No padding bytes in the struct.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster UI updates and clearer, more concise status indicators for colonists.
